security_audit.summary: All 53 static findings are false positives in Flutter documentation and code examples. The flagged key, state-expression, command, and URL patterns do not show credential access, unauthorized execution, exfiltration, or prompt injection.

remediation.suggestion: Retain the constructor examples, and improve scanner rules to distinguish Dart `super.key` from credential or certificate material.

remediation.issue: Static analysis labels ordinary state expressions as system reconnaissance.
remediation.suggestion: Retain the state-management examples, and classify Dart state access and boolean expressions separately from host or environment discovery.

remediation.issue: Static analysis labels documented Flutter commands and documentation URLs as execution or network risks.
remediation.suggestion: Keep commands limited to the stated development workflow and use trusted documentation links. Scanner rules should distinguish Markdown examples and fixed documentation URLs from runtime behavior.

content.value_statement: Flutter projects can become difficult to structure, test, and optimize as features grow. This skill provides focused Dart guidance for maintainable widgets, state, navigation, and performance.
actual_capabilities: Design feature-based Flutter project structures with clear data, domain, and presentation layers.
Create reusable, responsive, and const-optimized Flutter widgets.
Implement Riverpod providers, notifiers, asynchronous state, and selective rebuilds.
Implement Bloc and Cubit event-to-state flows with listeners and tests.
Configure GoRouter routes, redirects, nested routes, shell routes, and parameters.
Suggest Flutter testing and profiling workflows using Flutter tooling.
limitations: It provides guidance and code drafts, but it cannot run or verify your Flutter project.
It does not replace platform-specific testing on physical iOS or Android devices.
It does not guarantee dependency compatibility, production security, or release readiness.
It does not provide backend services, app store submission, or infrastructure automation.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Flutter Feature
use_cases.description: Turn a feature request into folders, Dart classes, state boundaries, routes, and focused tests.

use_cases.title: Improve State Management
use_cases.description: Choose Riverpod, Bloc, or Cubit and design predictable state transitions for screens and workflows.

use_cases.title: Fix UI Performance Issues
use_cases.description: Review rebuild patterns, list rendering, const usage, and profiling steps for smoother Flutter interfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Flutter Widget
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Flutter widget for [feature]. Include accessible layout, const constructors where possible, and a short explanation of each public property.

prompt_templates.title: Add Riverpod State
prompt_templates.prompt: Design Riverpod state for [feature]. Define the provider or notifier, loading and error states, widget usage, and focused tests.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Authenticated Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GoRouter design for [routes] with an authentication redirect. Explain nested routes, parameters, and how unauthenticated users are handled.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Flutter Jank
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Flutter screen description: [description]. Identify likely rebuild or rendering costs, propose measurable fixes, and define tests or profiling checks.

output_examples.input: Add a counter screen using Riverpod and keep rebuilds scoped.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan defines a counter provider, a ConsumerWidget, a const screen constructor, and a widget test for increment behavior.

output_examples.input: Protect dashboard routes when a user is signed out.
output_examples.output: The design uses a GoRouter redirect, permits authentication routes, and returns signed-out users to the login screen.

output_examples.input: Investigate dropped frames in a long scrolling list.
output: Profile in release-like mode and inspect rebuild counts.
Use lazy list construction, const child widgets, and RepaintBoundary where measurements support them.

best_practices: Describe the Flutter version, target platforms, packages, and current architecture before requesting changes.
Ask for focused code, tests, and reasoning for one feature or performance issue at a time.
Validate generated guidance with flutter analyze, flutter test, and device profiling in your project.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for running tests on every supported platform.
Do not place all application state in one global provider or massive Bloc.
Do not accept dependency, authentication, or performance advice without checking project context.

faq.question: Which Flutter versions does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Flutter 3+ and Dart. Confirm package APIs against your installed Flutter version.

faq.question: Can it choose Riverpod or Bloc?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare both approaches and recommend one based on state complexity, team conventions, and testing needs.

faq.question: Can it create navigation guards?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft GoRouter redirects, nested routes, shell routes, path parameters, and query parameters.

faq.question: Does it support responsive layouts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can design LayoutBuilder-based layouts and responsive widget boundaries for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

faq.question: Can it fix performance problems automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest profiling steps and likely fixes, but you must measure and verify changes in your application.

faq.question: Does it run Flutter commands?
faq.answer: The skill documents commands such as flutter analyze and flutter test. Run them in your trusted development environment.
